fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV's doctors confirm 'no further treatment is necessary'

titular: Doctors: Pope Leo needs no further treatment
bajada: Tumor removed Oct. 13 confirmed as localized lung adenocarcinoma
caption: Pope Leo XIV's medical team has confirmed that the tumor removed during his October 13 surgery was a localized lung adenocarcinoma, adding that no further treatment is necessary. Source: Vatican News, Oct. 21, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Exterior of a hospital or Vatican medical wing at dusk, soft lights in windows, calm atmosphere, upper right third shows a doctor's white coat on a chair, left and center space clear.
